description: Whether a project can be built on a US property (a backyard home or ADU, an addition, a garage or shed, a fence, a new home, or a lot split), from what the record says about its district: status (yes, yes with limits, no, depends, or unread where the deciding rules have not been read), a plain-words answer, and its basis (the layer that decided it, with its read date). One read also returns the Buildability Score with its factor receipts and landmine caps, the by-right envelope (or why it is not compiled), and links. With no project named, every project is answered. A first read takes 10–20 s; a recent read answers from cache.

project.description: The project to answer. Omit to answer every project.

property.description: The property being researched, not the user's location: a US street address, e.g. "412 Oak St, Austin, TX".

response_format.description: "concise" (default) leaves out factor notes and verbatim code quotes; every number keeps its source and read date. "detailed" returns them.

name: what_can_i_build

address.description: The address the geocoder matched; every answer is about this one.

answers.description: One answer per project asked (every project when none was named).

basis.description: What the answer rests on: the layer that decided it, who it is (cite), a public statute URL where one applies, and that layer's read date.

confirmed.description: The city's own staff confirmed the rules ("per the City").

inReport.description: What the full report holds for this project, by name only.

status.description: "unread" means we have not read the rules that decide it; never a no.

cite.description: One sentence an agent can quote, with the read date.

envelope.description: What the lot holds by right (the envelope tool's answer). compiled:false says why; district_rules then carries the district's published, cited standards where the Atlas has read them.

links.description: score_page is the link to cite.

property.description: The property as the caller wrote it.

band.description: The analytic band enum: Excellent, Good, Moderate or Poor. Show bandLabel to a person, not this.

bandLabel.description: The band as buildability.us names it on the page. Use this word whenever the band is said to a person.

boundBy.description: Key of the landmine in capsApplied that set the Score, or null when none capped it.

capsApplied.description: Landmines that cap the Score (e.g. a regulatory floodway). Empty when none.

coverage.description: Of the factors that enter the Score (role "weighted"), how many were read for this one. Context factors are not counted here.

factors.description: Every factor the score version reads. role "context" factors are reported but do not enter the Score. A factor whose status is not "read" has no subScore and is not counted; its reason says why.

record.description: The record behind a read factor (a resolvable URL), null when the engine has none.

matchedAddress.description: The address the geocoder matched and the Score is about.

parcelIdentity.description: matched:false means no county parcel record was read for this address: do not state APN, owner, lot size or outline. note says why.

provisional.description: True when a factor that enters the Score could not be read on this run; the Score may change when it is. Say so, and offer to ask again.

status.description: ic_ready, caution or high_risk. A provisional Score cannot be ic_ready: an unavailable weighted factor makes an otherwise ready result caution. This is a screening status, not a permit approval.

zoningNumbersHeld.description: True when the district's dimensional numbers (height, coverage, FAR, min lot, setbacks, density) are on record but not in this answer.

title: What can I build on a property
